narrative.headline: 2018 Ram 1500: electrical and engine issues lead owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 639 owner complaints to NHTSA, the electrical system is the most-reported area at 156 reports (24%), followed by the engine at 108 reports (17%). Most complaints did not involve a crash, fire, or injury. The electrical system reports account for the most harm in this data, with 4 crashes, 3 fires, and 6 injuries; the engine category adds 3 more fires and 3 injuries.

issues.title: Electrical System

issues.title: Engine
